Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. We've attached Acme's final set of redlines to the MSA (MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) and a marked-up Order Form. We're ready to sign as soon as we align on two things:

1) DocuSign sequencing — Acme prefers simultaneous execution but can do sequential if Redwood needs to control envelope order for the dedicated capacity add-on.
2) Signer authority confirmation — I listed the expected signers in the attached signature-roster.xlsx; legal (Emily copied) will confirm official signing capacity.

Claire —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear roster. Short answer: yes to both, with a recommended fast-path to minimize back-and-forth. Proposed approach below — happy to adjust if Acme prefers otherwise.

DocuSign fast-path (Redwood recommendation):
- We prepare two envelopes: 1) MSA (sequential: Redwood legal -> Acme signers) 2) Order Form (simultaneous with MSA final signer where feasible).
- If Acme wants simultaneous full execution, we can set the envelopes to routing order = parallel, but Redwood will flag the dedicated capacity add-on to sign last to ensure internal provisioning checklist completes before financial trigger.
- Audit evidence: DocuSign certificate + PDF archive provided; if Acme requires notarization we can support through our partner (extra step, please confirm).

Signer authority & clean copies:
- Marissa (cc'd) will run the signature roster against Redwood's KYC/authority checklist and confirm acceptable signatory names and titles.
- After final signatures we will publish a clean, stamped PDF and an execution log to the shared drive link (I will post).

Next steps (action items):
- Claire/Emily: confirm whether Acme needs notarization or is OK with DocuSign audit trail only.
- Marissa: prepare envelope routing + attach clean Order Form (we'll produce OrderForm_CleanCopy.pdf).
- Karthik: hold on provisioning until we have at least the MSA fully executed or an approved fallback policy.
- Ben: please prepare a one-page evidence packet we can hand to Acme's procurement if they ask for a timestamped audit trail and signatory ID confirmation.

I'll queue the envelopes once we get Emily's nod on signers and notarization.

— Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments included: OrderForm_CleanCopy.pdf, signer-evidence-template.docx (we'll use this to capture driver's license + org chart if Acme requires extra proof).
